leafTrees.description: Leaves need the sum-law call under their OWN tests; composites, tests of the law-less kind and shared mutations-level tests do not count.

A leaf without a `🔺️diff` directory is a `🦀️.rs` implementing `MutationKind`; it is tested by a law call under its own `🧪️tests` or by a family test of its subset whose law-calling fn (or a same-file helper/caller of it) NAMES its payload type. A shared loop over cases defined elsewhere, a test in another subset, a type spelled in a fn that never reaches the law, a leaf without a `MutationKind` impl and a composite do not count.
